explicit_validation.explanation: The paper conducts both LLM-based and human evaluations but does not compare their results or report any quantitative agreement metrics between LLM and human judgments. The evaluations are performed on the same summaries but are treated as independent assessment methods without direct validation.

prompts.notes: The paper describes the AB test format and criteria but does not provide full verbatim prompts. It mentions questions comparing summaries on factual consistency and accurate source representation, with ordering reversed to avoid bias.

guidelines.notes: Detailed annotation guidelines are mentioned in Appendix A. Human evaluation used multiple-choice questions similar to LLM setup, asking about factual consistency and accurate source representation.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluation assess the same criteria (factual consistency and accurate representation of source transcript) using similar AB test formats with multiple-choice questions.
